say:2:1410444001:0.text: Indris, look! I've cultivated a new variant! This is the mirage bloom, restored based on my notes!
say:2:1410444001:0.source_cn: 因度厄，快看！我培育出来的新品种！这是我根据笔记复原的...

say:4:1410444003:0.text: If you want them to grow well, you must sprinkle some Divine Dew on the seeds.
say:4:1410444003:0.source_cn: 嗯！想让它好好生长，必须将恩典灵露播撒在种子上。

say:5:1410444004:0.text: Once the mirage bloom flowers, it releases an illusion to stay hidden from predators.
say:5:1410444004:0.source_cn: 幻影花一旦发芽，就会自动释放幻象，这是为了避免被捕食者发现。

say:6:1410444005:1.text: And the mirage bloom also responds to the planter's emotions—joy, serenity, or even longing for something ideal... They bloom according to how the planter feels.
say:6:1410444005:1.source_cn: 另外，幻影花还需要种植者与它分享一种情绪，喜悦、平静，...

say:7:1410444006:1.text: Speaking of the mirage bloom—ah! Sorry, I got carried away.
say:7:1410444006:1.source_cn: 说到幻影花——啊……啊啊啊！不好意思！我忽然唠叨个没完。

say:8:1410444007:0.text: Your skills have truly improved. It's impressive.
say:8:1410444007:0.source_cn: 你的能力又精进了，令人钦佩。

say:9:1410444008:1.text: Right? Even my fellow priests praise me now, saying I'll match the achievements of my ancestors one day!
say:9:1410444008:1.source_cn: 是吧，是吧！连其他祭司同僚都夸我呢，说我有朝一日一定能...

choice_prompt:10:1410444008.text: Right? Even my fellow priests praise me now, saying I'll match the achievements of my ancestors one day!
choice_prompt:10:1410444008.source_cn: 是吧，是吧！连其他祭司同僚都夸我呢，说我有朝一日一定能赶上祖先们的成就！

say:13:1410444010:0.text: Merlin is the newest recruit I've brought into the guard.
say:13:1410444010:0.source_cn: 梅林是我为卫队招募的新成员。
say:13:1410444010:0.male: Merlin is the newest recruit I've brought into the guard.
say:13:1410444010:0.female: Merlin is the newest recruit I've brought into the guard.

say:14:1410444011:1.text: Oh! So you're Indris' new subordinate.
say:14:1410444011:1.source_cn: 哦哦，原来是你的新部下。
say:14:1410444011:1.male: Oh! So you're Indris' new subordinate.
say:14:1410444011:1.female: Oh! So you're Indris' new subordinate.

say:15:1410444012:1.text: Well, nice to meet you, Merlin! You seem interested in my ancestors. Allow me to give you a brief introduction.
say:15:1410444012:1.source_cn: 梅林你好！你似乎对我的祖先感兴趣，那我来给你简单讲讲吧。
say:15:1410444012:1.male: Well, nice to meet you, Merlin! You seem interested in my ancestors. Allow me to give you a brief introduction.
say:15:1410444012:1.female: Well, nice to meet you, Merlin! You seem interested in my ancestors. Allow me to give you a brief introduction.

say:16:1410444013:1.text: My ancestor is <style="highlight">Sage Tasso</style>, who aided the Queen in the founding of Sal'thorin.
say:16:1410444013:1.male: My ancestor is <style="highlight">Sage Tasso</style>, who aided the Queen in the founding of Sal'thorin.
say:16:1410444013:1.female: My ancestor is <style="highlight">Sage Tasso</style>, who aided the Queen in the founding of Sal'thorin.

say:17:1410444014:0.text: Sage Tasso was the Queen's right hand.
say:17:1410444014:0.source_cn: 塔萨贤者可谓是女王的左右手。
say:17:1410444014:0.male: Sage Tasso was the Queen's right hand.
say:17:1410444014:0.female: Sage Tasso was the Queen's right hand.

say:18:1410444015:1.text: Two thousand years ago, our home was ravaged by Hypogeans, and our forest lost its vitality.

say:22:1410444017:1.male: This! It's the family heirloom Sage Tasso left behind.

say:23:1410444018:1.source_cn: 织叶蕴含着自然魔力，超级厉害！在培育植物时帮了我好大的忙。

say:27:1410444020:1.female: Oh, right! Indris, you brought Merlin here for a reason, didn't you?

say:29:1410444022:1.text: What? Just for entering the city? And the High Priestess personally intervened? How strict!
say:29:1410444022:1.source_cn: 诶？只是误入就惊动了奎茵冕下亲自出手吗？真是严苛！

say:30:1410444023:0.source_cn: 梅林，把你的印记给斐利尔看看。

choice_prompt:31:1410444023.source_cn: 梅林，把你的印记给斐利尔看看。

say:32:1410444024:1.text: Don't worry, this is just a minor warning. The Stigma isn't too complex. The High Priestess didn't put much effort into it.
say:32:1410444024:1.source_cn: 别担心，这不过是一个小小的警告。惩罚印记的术式并不是很...
say:32:1410444024:1.male: Don't worry, this is just a minor warning. The Stigma isn't too complex. The High Priestess didn't put much effort into it.
say:32:1410444024:1.female: Don't worry, this is just a minor warning. The Stigma isn't too complex. The High Priestess didn't put much effort into it.

say:34:1410444026:1.text: Alright, alright, I get it. I'm not disrespecting the High Priestess... I'm just speaking objectively. Don't be so sensitive, Indris.
say:34:1410444026:1.source_cn: 好了好了，我明白你要说什么。我没有不尊敬她的意思……只...

say:35:1410444027:1.text: Speaking of which, is your mark alright? I can help you remove yours, too.
say:35:1410444027:1.source_cn: 说起来，因度厄，你的印记不要紧吗？我帮你一起消除吧。

say:36:1410444028:0.text: I made a mistake. The Stigma serves as a reminder of that.
say:36:1410444028:0.source_cn: 我确实铸成了错误，惩罚印记是一种潜在的提醒。

say:37:1410444029:0.text: As captain of the guard, I have duties I can't escape. Even if the mark is removed, the burden in my heart remains.
say:37:1410444029:0.source_cn: 作为卫队长，我有不能逃避的职责。就算消除了体表的印记，...

say:38:1410444030:1.text: But if you go too long without Divine Dew, your strength will be affected...
say:38:1410444030:1.source_cn: 但是太久不喝恩典灵露，你的力量会受到影响的……

say:39:1410444031:0.text: Feli, thank you for your concern. But accepting punishment for my mistakes is a belief I hold strongly.
say:39:1410444031:0.source_cn: 斐利尔，多谢你的关心。但犯错之后接受惩罚，这也是我不可...

say:40:1410444032:1.text: You're so stubborn, but alright... That's just how you are. I'll keep a close eye on you, though!
say:40:1410444032:1.source_cn: 真是固执呢，不过好吧，这就是因度厄。我这几天会密切看顾...

say:41:1410444033:1.text: Now, Merlin. Please extend your arm.
say:41:1410444033:1.source_cn: 那么轮到你了，梅林。请伸出手臂——
